name: Your furniture
source: The furniture kit from the renter's earlier layout studios: the Fit check (three plans), Room to live (two plans) and the Apartment layout studio (Emerald Green 1211), plus the queen-bed and 55-inch TV study for Emerald Green 1211. The renter then confirmed the desk (about 71 in long, brown wood, with a rolling task chair and a 32-inch monitor) and that both TVs are 55-inch. No saved positions survived from the earlier tools (they kept drags in the browser only), so positions are the renter's answers about each room, checked with the studio's fit checks.

pieces.label: Queen bed

look.note: Upholstered grey fabric frame and headboard. The renter gave the colour and the upholstery; the exact shade is a mid grey.

pieces.note: Mattress 60 x 80 in on a 64 x 84 in frame with a 40 in headboard.
pieces.source: Fit check; Room to live uses a 62 x 84 in frame; the TV study uses a 60 x 80 in mattress.

pieces.label: Latitude Run bed

look.note: Brown Oak: a medium warm brown oak with fine straight grain, matt to satin, darker inside the cubbies, with two warm off-white padded panels and black metal fittings. Colours sampled from the maker's photos (the wood about #937761 in light), not from a swatch.

candidate.name: Modern Storage Platform Bed With Integrated Nightstands, Upholstered Headboard, LED Reading Lights & 4 Drawers
candidate.materials: Solid and manufactured wood (oak), velvet upholstery, plug-in power; two built-in USB-C and USB charging ports and a reading light in each tower.
candidate.note: Read by the renter from the product page's Specifications table, its dimension drawing and its product photos; the page itself was not fetched by the studio. The table and the drawing differ by under 1 in on the frame (61.42 W x 83.46 L x 47.24 H for the frame alone, 60.5 x 83.3 x 47.4 on the drawing); the model uses the drawing's figures. The 13 in is the whole side of the oak box from the floor (its front is two 11.8 in drawer fronts on about 1.2 in black feet); the 4.5 in floor clearance is read as the clearance under the inner black metal frame, not the gap under the oak. The 13.8 in on the drawing is the height of the nightstand's underside above the floor (its top, 22 in, is level with the mattress top). The rail, panel, band and cubby sizes are measured from the front photo against the 94 in width (about 1 in either way); the 12 in mattress is chosen inside the maker's 10 to 15 in. Prices are deliberately not recorded.

pieces.note: A bed you may buy, modelled to the maker's dimensions. It comes with its own nightstands, so the separate ones are hidden while it is shown.

pieces.label: Nightstand
pieces.note: The second nightstand; the Apartment layout studio kept it hidden by default.

pieces.label: IKEA STORKLINTA 6-drawer dresser

look.note: IKEA's dark brown oak effect, a printed oak-grain foil. The renter sees it as near black in their room, so it is drawn a little dark; the exact finish is a stand-in.

pieces.note: IKEA STORKLINTA 6-drawer dresser, dark brown oak effect, 70 x 48 x 120 cm: two small drawers side by side on top, then four full-width ones (inside 61 x 40 x 16 cm), slab fronts with no handles, a thin top, a recessed plinth on small feet. Tall and narrow, with a wall anchor.
pieces.source: manufacturer: IKEA US article 705.592.78, https://www.ikea.com/us/en/p/storklinta-6-drawer-dresser-dark-brown-oak-effect-anchor-unlock-function-70559278/ (product page measurements and drawing). Renter, 2026-10-15: this is their dresser, not the MALM.

pieces.label: Desk, chair and monitor

look.note: Brown wood, the renter's own. The legs, the finish, the chair's black and the monitor's casing are stand-ins.

pieces.note: The renter's desk, about 71 in (180 cm) long, brown wood. The depth is not known: 30 in is assumed. A rolling task chair (five-star base on casters, gas lift, padded back, armrests) and a 32-inch 16:9 monitor (28.0 x 15.8 in screen) stand with it.
pieces.source: Renter, 2026-10-15: desk about 180 cm long, brown wood; an office chair with wheels; a 32-inch monitor. Earlier tools used 60 x 24 in (Fit check), 72 x 24 in (Room to live) and 54 x 24 in (Apartment layout studio).

pieces.label: Futon, Serta Billie-Loren

look.note: Black faux leather (the renter's purchase emails: Serta Billie-Loren, WADL9387, variant 19198029) with four splayed brushed-chrome legs as in Wayfair's product photo; the sheen is read from that photo.

pieces.note: Click-clack sofa bed: 73.2 x 33.5 x 35.4 in upright (Wayfair also lists the sofa as 74 in wide), about 73.2 x 39.9 x 30 in as a lounger (worked out from the back length, not listed), 73.2 x 41.7 in as a flat bed. Seat 22.0 in deep, 18.5 in high. No size is verified for this variant.
pieces.source: Renter's purchase emails, Aug 2023 (Wayfair, WADL9387, variant 19198029); sizes: Wayfair listing result, basis: listing (unverified for this variant).

confirmed.note: The renter confirmed these are their own pieces, and on 2026-10-15 their colours and materials (each piece's `look`, where its basis is renter). A field listed in `assumed`, the TVs' casing and the chairs are stand-ins. The Latitude Run storage bed is not one of the renter's pieces: it is a candidate purchase, modelled from the maker's dimensions.
